scientific_role: prediction-first mechanism probe for a WeCLIP-inspired but radiograph-specific frozen RAD-DINO spatial decoder and local affinity refinement; not a pseudo-mask selection run and not a segmentation-consumer run
scientific_question: Can a lightweight spatial decoder trained only from BTXRD image labels and a frozen clean-normal RAD-DINO anomaly teacher improve shape-aware validation localization over the frozen nominal-memory single-scale arm, especially for small tumors?
hypothesis: Frozen radiograph-pretrained spatial tokens plus label-free grayscale/gradient guidance, image-level SmoothMax BCE, confidence-ranked nominal-memory pseudo supervision, and learned local affinity constrained by frozen token affinity will expand sparse nominal evidence into more coherent tumor shapes without task-specific spatial annotations.

training_allowed: deterministic image-derived grayscale and finite-difference guidance
pseudo evidence reconstructed only from clean-train normal RAD-DINO features
training_forbidden: BTXRD boxes, points, scribbles, lesion size, anatomy-derived GT strata, or annotation hashes
validation images or labels for optimization, epoch selection, calibration, or hyperparameter fitting
weak_supervision_contract.epoch_selection: fixed final epoch 12; no validation selection
weak_supervision_contract.validation_gt: may be imported only after all 371 validation maps, their manifest, the final checkpoint, and prediction_freeze.json have been written and hash-bound

backbone.input: black square pad then bicubic resize to 448x448 with frozen RAD-DINO normalization

normal_memory_teacher.role: training-only pseudo teacher; reconstructed without validation data
normal_memory_teacher.feature_projection: seed-42 frozen Gaussian projection 768-to-128 followed by L2 normalization
normal_memory_teacher.context: top 8 normal images by normalized CLS cosine; leave-one-image-out for each normal calibration image
normal_memory_teacher.patch_distance: one minus maximum cosine similarity within plus/minus 2 patch coordinates in retrieved normal context
normal_memory_teacher.calibration: empirical CDF fitted on leave-one-image-out train-normal patch distances only
normal_memory_teacher.positive_teacher: calibrated 32x32 patch anomaly ranks for each of 1488 train-tumor images

architecture.guidance: label-free 64x64 grayscale, signed horizontal difference, and signed vertical difference; 3x3 convolution to 32 channels
architecture.output: bilinear token-feature upsample to 64x64, guidance fusion, one residual block, 1-channel logit

local_affinity.learned: sigmoid of normalized decoder-feature cosine divided by temperature 0.20
local_affinity.frozen_filter: nonnegative normalized RAD-DINO token cosine raised to power 2
local_affinity.confidence_mining: within the deterministic unpadded content region at native 32x32 teacher resolution; top 1% foreground rank and bottom 50% background rank, disjoint by construction
local_affinity.seed_resize: nearest-neighbor upsampling preserves every native foreground seed

loss.image_level: binary cross entropy over alpha-12 SmoothMax of the 64x64 sigmoid map
loss.pseudo: per-image balanced foreground/background BCE for tumor images; all-background BCE for normal images
loss.affinity: balanced same/different confident-pair BCE over non-self local pairs in tumor images

optimization.augmentation: train-only horizontal flip p=0.5 applied identically to tokens, guidance, teacher, and validity

frozen_validation_prediction.normalization: sigmoid probability only; no per-image min-max
frozen_validation_prediction.geometry: crop the exact original-image content box from the 64x64 square-frame probability map, bilinear resize to 320x320, then zero only the deterministic image-derived radiograph background
frozen_validation_prediction.image_score: p99 probability within the deterministic radiograph foreground

continuous: image-level AUROC from foreground p99 over all 371 images
pixel AP over each tumor image
pixel AUROC over each tumor image
evaluation.comparison: decoder minus nominal baseline for every continuous and fixed diagnostic, paired complete-group bootstrap with 10000 replicates and seed family 20260727

predeclared_mechanistic_gate.on_pass: retain the mechanism only; pseudo-mask selection and any segmentation consumer require a separate predeclared protocol
predeclared_mechanistic_gate.on_fail: reject this fixed configuration without fitting thresholds to the observed validation result

relation_to_validation_goal.interpretation: this probe cannot itself satisfy the final consumer goal; it tests whether its spatial mechanism is strong enough to justify the next separately frozen pseudo-mask/consumer experiment
